text.en:
The National Highway starting from the corner of Leon Kilat Street, along the bus terminal, the
south expressway in Cebu City in what is commonly known as the Cebu South Expressway and/or the Cebu
South Road in Cebu City and Province of Cebu up to the Municipality of Santander, Cebu, shall be known as
the Natalio B. Bacalso South National Highway.

Any law, ordinance, administrative order or designation or identification shall be considered
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 7, 1984
